case_rule: Union of all 31 original eligible cases and all pre-outcome absolute-risk diagnostic cases; deduplicate by source/state/ordered pair, never by event
teacher_H: Uniform nonempty supported absolute-risk bin, then uniform supported action cell within bin
scope: Action-conditional collision-label exploration only. Training access no longer requires strict cooperative eligibility. Production unchanged. Very low P actions may add event sources without meaningful natural risk; never equate raw source yield with IS efficiency or PPO readiness.
budget_rule: Freeze complete positive/negative state union and action distribution before outcomes. No forced witness labels, outcome-based case substitutions, extra draws, validation fitting, or PPO export.
